300 std::unordered_map<uint8_t, channel_info> supported_channels;
301
309 beerocks::eFreqType get_frequency_band() const
310 {
311 if (supported_channels.empty()) {
312 return beerocks::eFreqType::FREQ_UNKNOWN;
313 }
314
315 return son::wireless_utils::which_freq_type(
316 supported_channels.begin()->second.center_freq);

318
324 bool is_5ghz_band() const { return beerocks::eFreqType::FREQ_5G == get_frequency_band(); }
325
331 beerocks::eWiFiBandwidth get_max_bandwidth() const
332 {
333 beerocks::eWiFiBandwidth max_bandwith = beerocks::eWiFiBandwidth::BANDWIDTH_UNKNOWN;
334
335 for (const auto &it : supported_channels) {
336 channel_info channel = it.second;
337 max_bandwith = std::max(max_bandwith, channel.get_max_bandwidth());
338 }
339
340 return max_bandwith;
341 }
